scope: navigation-only planar simulation; high-level velocity output for future Unitree built-in gait integration

frames.odometry: current ego/base[x_m,y_m,yaw_rad] in one consistent world/odometry frame
frames.camera_pose: ego/base[x_m,y_m,yaw_rad] at RGB capture time, NOT optical camera origin; camera extrinsic is applied separately from config
frames.lidar_xyz: Nx3 measured points in CURRENT navigation frame[x_forward,y_left,z_up], already ego-motion-compensated from scan_time
frames.lidar_valid_mask: N boolean flags; missing/no-return is unknown, never free
frames.measured_twist: current measured forward speed m/s and yaw rate rad/s
frames.local_goal: 2-vector in current navigation XY; external route guidance, no global map needed by Navigator

timestamps: time and scan_time are monotonic seconds on same clock; camera_pose matches RGB timestamp
images: uint8 RGB240x320x3; not BGR/stereo or simulated segmentation masks
outputs: vx m/s, vy=0 m/s, yaw_rate rad/s; not joint targets
sim_preconditions: flat ground and calibrated level camera
not_validated: real sensor6DOF calibration or odometry drift
